about:
Urth Apparel Inc. is a custom apparel manufacturer headquartered in Newport Beach, California. The company was founded in 2013 when its founder launched an international trade cooperative focused on natural foods and cotton apparel from Peru. The venture grew from a desire to find manufacturing partners that shared a commitment to both fashionable design and ecological responsibility.

Urth Apparel manages the full product development cycle, including fashion and technical design, fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making, grading, marker making, sampling, cutting and sewing, screen printing, sublimation, heat transfer, finishing, packaging, and inspection. Production is distributed across three origins: luxury clothing in Italy, knitwear and basics in Peru, and specialty technical apparel in the United States. The company operates dedicated production lines for tees, tanks, and polos, and emphasizes sustainable and organic materials. The core team at headquarters numbers three employees.

The company serves clothing brands and designers of all sizes, from startups to established labels. Its portfolio spans tees, tanks, polos, dresses, kids and baby apparel, yoga and athleisure wear, swimwear, and dress shirts. Industries served include fashion apparel, sustainable and organic clothing, activewear, swimwear, and children’s wear.

The founders created Urth Apparel after struggling to find factories that combined quality, sustainability, and fair labor practices. The company’s stated philosophy is to “do it right, take care of the planet, take care of your workers, create clothing that lasts.” It positions itself as a one-stop partner that handles design, sourcing, and logistics, with daily communication between design teams and production floors.
